findings: The CleanupLoadingAnimation.vue component faithfully implements the provided SVG loading animation spec: 4-icon carousel with synchronized dots-visibility, parallax mouse tracking, and proper lifecycle cleanup. Integration in CleaningItem.vue correctly replaces DlSpinner with the new component, passing the progress prop. Unique IDs prevent DOM collisions when multiple instances exist. Responsive sizing constraints (max 480px, min 120px) and DlProgressBar are included. Build succeeds cleanly.

issues.description: Hardcoded id="layer-1" and id="layer-2" on the SVG <g> elements are vestigial from the original HTML (where they were used by getElementById). They are not referenced by any JS in the Vue component but could cause duplicate ID warnings if multiple component instances ever coexist in the DOM.
